title: 第29章 不请自来的好意
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
周三中午，苏念念的手机响了。

    她正啃着一只鸡腿，嘴角沾着油，看了一眼屏幕，嘴里含含糊糊地说了句“周小鱼”，接起来。

    安槐坐在对面吃面，耳朵没闲着。

    “什么？不是我说的啊。”苏念念把鸡腿换到右手，左手拿手机，“谁传的？群里？”

    安槐抬头看她。

    苏念念的表情从疑惑变成了恼火。

    挂了电话，她把手机扔在桌上。

    “有人在年级群里说我排位赛那天用了违规手段，说我的回流掌不是学校教的功法，疑似外挂。”

    安槐放下筷子。

    “谁发的？”

    “匿名的，年级群里有个匿名吐槽频道，谁都可以发，内容是'苏念念排位赛使用疑似外部渠道获取的非常规功法，建议教务处核实'。”

    安槐沉默了一秒钟。

    回流掌。

    他教给苏念念的武技，这东西确实不是学校课程里的内容，但也不是什么禁术邪功，联邦武道体系里有大量民间流传的辅助武技，学生自行修习完全合法。

    问题不在于合不合规，而在于谁发的，以及目的是什么。

    “老大别急。”安槐的语气很平，“回流掌的来源可以追溯到联邦基础武技库，是公开功法的衍生手法，学校没有禁止学生使用课外武技的规定。”

    苏念念冷笑了一声。

    “我当然知道没问题，但这条消息发出去，不明真相的人一看，就会觉得我是靠歪门邪道赢的比赛。”

    安槐点头。

    这是一种典型的舆论操控手段，不需要坐实什么，只需要质疑一下，就足以让人心里打鼓。

    “我去找方远。”安槐站起来。

    苏念念拉住他的袖子。

    “干什么？”

    “让方远以班主任身份出个说明就行，排位赛期间所有参赛学生的功法使用记录教务处都有备案，说明是合规武技，谣言自动消失。”

    苏念念松开手。

    “你脑子转得也太快了。”

    安槐笑了笑。

    “理科生的优势。”

    他端着餐盘去回收处的时候，余光扫了一眼食堂角落。

    林落雪坐在远处的桌子旁边，跟几个女生有说有笑，她手里拿着手机，手指在屏幕上划了两下，放下了。

    安槐收回目光。

    他没有证据证明那条匿名消息跟林落雪有关，但时间点太巧了，排位赛结束一周，谣言刚好在苏念念风头最盛的时候出现。

    先解决问题，再查源头。

    安槐找到方远办公室的时候，方远正在批改作业。

    “方老师，有件事想跟您说一下。”

    方远抬头看他，放下笔。
content_en:
At noon on Wednesday, Su Niannian's cell phone rang.

She was chewing on a chicken leg, with oil on the corner of her mouth. She glanced at the screen, mumbled "Zhou Xiaoyu" and picked up.

An Huai sat across from him eating noodles, his ears busy.

"What? I didn't say that." Su Niannian moved the drumstick to her right hand and held the phone in her left hand, "Who passed it on? In the group?"

An Huai looked up at her.

Su Niannian's expression changed from puzzled to annoyed.

After hanging up the phone, she threw the phone on the table.

"Someone in the grade group said that I used illegal methods on the day of qualifying. They said that my Return Palm was not a skill taught in the school and was suspected of being a cheat."

An Huai put down his chopsticks.

"Who sent it?"

"Anonymous. There is an anonymous complaint channel in the grade group. Anyone can post it. The content is 'Su Niannian used unconventional exercises that are suspected to be obtained from external channels in the qualifying competition. It is recommended that the Academic Affairs Office verify'."

An Huai was silent for a second.

Return palm.

The martial arts skills he taught Su Niannian were indeed not part of the school curriculum, but they were not forbidden or evil skills. There were a large number of auxiliary martial arts skills spread among the people in the federal martial arts system, and it was completely legal for students to practice on their own.

The question is not whether it is compliant or not, but who issued it and for what purpose.

"Don't worry, boss." An Huai's tone was calm, "The origin of the Return Palm can be traced back to the federal basic martial arts library. It is a derivative of the public martial arts. The school has no regulations prohibiting students from using extracurricular martial arts."

Su Niannian sneered.

"Of course I know there is no problem, but if this news is sent out, people who don't know the truth will think that I won the game through crooked ways."

An Huai nodded.

This is a typical method of manipulating public opinion. It doesn’t require anything to be proven, it just needs to be questioned, which is enough to make people feel excited.

"I'm going to find Fang Yuan." An Huai stood up.

Su Niannian pulled his sleeve.

"What?"

"Just let Fang Yuan give an explanation as the class teacher. During the qualifying competition, the records of the martial arts used by all participating students have been filed in the Academic Affairs Office, indicating that they are legal martial arts, and the rumors will disappear automatically."

Su Niannian let go of her hand.

"Your mind is moving too fast."

An Huai smiled.

"The Advantages of Science Students."

When he was carrying the plate to the recycling area, he glanced at the corner of the canteen from the corner of his eye.

Lin Luoxue was sitting at a table in the distance, talking and laughing with a few girls. She held the mobile phone in her hand, swiped her fingers on the screen twice, and put it down.

An Huai looked back.

He had no evidence to prove that the anonymous message was related to Lin Luoxue, but the timing was too coincidental. One week after the qualifying competition, the rumor appeared just when Su Niannian was at his peak.

Solve the problem first, then investigate the source.

When An Huai found Fang Yuan's office, Fang Yuan was correcting his homework.

"Teacher Fang, I have something to tell you."

Fang Yuan looked up at him and put down his pen.
